title: National Poverty Analysis Dashboard
content:
# Comprehensive Poverty Analysis

## Project Overview
We developed an interactive dashboard for monitoring poverty indicators across all provinces. The system integrates data from multiple sources including household surveys, census data, and satellite imagery.

## Key Features
- Real-time poverty mapping
- Predictive analytics for vulnerable populations
- Automated reporting system
- Multi-dimensional poverty index calculator

## Impact
- 30% improvement in targeting accuracy for social programs
- Reduced reporting time from 2 weeks to 2 days
- Enabled evidence-based policy decisions

title: Education Outcomes Monitoring System
content:
# Education Monitoring & Evaluation System

## Project Description
Developed a comprehensive M&E framework for tracking education outcomes in marginalized communities. The system tracks 15 key performance indicators across 200 schools.

## Technical Implementation
- Machine learning models for dropout prediction
- Mobile data collection using ODK
- Interactive Power BI dashboards
- Automated SMS alerts for critical indicators

## Results Achieved
- Early warning system identified 85% of potential dropouts
- Improved data collection accuracy by 40%
- Reduced reporting burden by 60%

![Education Dashboard](https://via.placeholder.com/600x400/36B37E/FFFFFF?text=Education+Monitoring)

title: Climate Change Vulnerability Assessment
content:
# Climate Vulnerability Analysis

## Project Scope
Comprehensive assessment of climate change impacts on agricultural productivity across 12 African countries.

## Methodology
- Satellite imagery analysis
- Climate modeling using RCP scenarios
- Household survey data integration
- GIS-based vulnerability mapping

## Key Findings
- Identified 3 high-risk zones requiring intervention
- Developed adaptation strategies for each region
- Created policy recommendations for climate resilience

## Tools Used
- Python for data analysis
- QGIS for mapping
- Tableau for visualization
- Stata for statistical analysis

![Climate Dashboard](https://via.placeholder.com/600x400/00B8D9/FFFFFF?text=Climate+Analysis)

title: Healthcare Access Analysis
content:
# Healthcare Access Mapping

## Project Background
Analysis of healthcare access disparities in Sub-Saharan Africa, focusing on maternal and child health services.

## Data Sources
- DHS surveys
- Health facility registry
- Mobile phone data
- Satellite imagery of road networks

## Analytical Approach
1. Geospatial analysis of service coverage
2. Travel time modeling using network analysis
3. Machine learning for demand prediction
4. Optimization modeling for facility placement

## Outcomes
- Identified 120 underserved communities
- Recommended 25 new health facility locations
- Developed mobile clinic routing schedules

![Healthcare Dashboard](https://via.placeholder.com/600x400/6554C0/FFFFFF?text=Healthcare+Access)

title: Financial Inclusion Research
content:
# Financial Inclusion Dashboard

## Research Objectives
1. Analyze mobile money penetration
2. Identify barriers to financial access
3. Recommend policy interventions
4. Develop monitoring framework

## Data Collection
- Survey of 5,000 households
- Mobile money transaction data
- Bank branch and ATM locations
- Agent network analysis

## Key Insights
- Mobile money increased access by 45%
- Gender gap persists in formal banking
- Rural areas still underserved
- Youth prefer digital channels

## Policy Recommendations
- Agent banking expansion
- Digital literacy programs
- Regulatory sandbox for fintech
- Gender-targeted interventions

![Financial Dashboard](https://via.placeholder.com/600x400/0052CC/FFFFFF?text=Financial+Inclusion)
